verses.text: For the music director. To be played on stringed instruments. A psalm of David. Answer me when I call, my God who makes me right. Give me relief from my troubles. Be kind to me and hear my prayer.
You people, how long will you turn my honour into shame? How long will you love what is worthless and chase after lies? Selah.
But know this: the LORD has chosen faithful people for himself. The LORD will hear me when I call to him.
Tremble and do not sin. When you are on your bed, think deeply and be quiet. Selah.
Offer the right sacrifices, and trust in the LORD.
Many people say, "Who will show us anything good?" LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.
You have filled my heart with more joy than people have when they have plenty of grain and new wine.
I will lie down and sleep in peace, because you alone, LORD, keep me safe.
